Talent0_2Ability.name: Thousand Schemes
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: At the start of action or when an ally uses a skill with <color=#F74848>4</color> AP cost or more, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks. At the end of action, can activate one of <skill activeSkill=5010501>[Stratagem - Respite]</skill>, <skill activeSkill=5010502>[Stratagem - Encouragement]</skill> or <skill activeSkill=5010503>[Stratagem - Bribery]</skill>. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf> consumed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010506>[Shrewdness]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>15</color> stacks.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Thousand Schemes
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
At the start of action or when an ally uses a skill with <color=#F74848>4</color> AP cost or more, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks. At the end of action, can activate one of <skill activeSkill=5010501>[Stratagem - Respite]</skill>, <skill activeSkill=5010502>[Stratagem - Encouragement]</skill> or <skill activeSkill=5010503>[Stratagem - Bribery]</skill>. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf> consumed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010506>[Shrewdness]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>15</color> stacks.
All parts maximum HP increase by <color=#F74848>10%</color>. At the start of battle, gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf> and <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=5010506>[Shrewdness]</buf>.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

501002.name: Foresight
501002.SpecificEffects: At the end of action, if <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf> stacks are <color=#F74848>3</color> or less, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010502>[Stratagem]</buf>.

501003.name: Situation Awareness
501003.describe: Chooses <skill activeSkill=5010031>[Stratagem - Investment]</skill> or <skill activeSkill=5010032>[Stratagem - Prepayment]</skill> to use, then continue to act with remaining movement.

501004.name: Burning Incense
501004.describe: Uses Flamethrower to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. If the target is on <terrian ID=4003081 />, deals <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> equal to <color=#F74848>0.15x</color> Flamethrower ATK to all parts of the target. Can activate <buf ID=5010468>[Stratagem Infusion]</buf> to double the <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> effect.

501005.name: Environment Advantage
501005.SpecificEffects: For all allies located on friendly <terrian ID=4003081 />, Repair AMT received increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color> and DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

501006.name: Firewalker
501006.describe: Enters <buf ID=5010061>[Firewalk]</buf> state which is removed at the end of turn. Can continue to act with remaining movement. Can activate <buf ID=5010468>[Stratagem Infusion]</buf> to gain <color=#F74848>2</color> AP after activation.

501007.name: Just In Time
501007.SpecificEffects: After an ally within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles is actively attacked, if their body HP is <color=#F74848>50%</color> or less, consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> PP to trigger <skill activeSkill=5010501>[Stratagem - Respite]</skill> for that ally with <buf ID=5010468>[Stratagem Infusion]</buf> upgrade. Gains <color=#F74848>2</color> PP at the start of battle.

501008.name: Fireworks
501008.describe: Uses Flamethrower to attack all targets within a <range type=1>4-tile fan-shaped</range> area in front, dealing <color=#F74848>0.8x</color> AoE DMG. Can activate <buf ID=5010468>[Stratagem Infusion]</buf> to apply <terrian ID=4003081 /> to all tiles within attack range, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

hiddenSkills.name: Flame Strike
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Flamethrower to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG and <color=#F74848>20%</color> <buf ID=900139>[Fire DMG]</buf> to other targets along the path. After combat, applies <terrian ID=4003081 /> to all tiles along the attack path, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Can activate <buf ID=5010468>[Stratagem Infusion]</buf> to increase <buf ID=900139>[Fire DMG]</buf> to <color=#F74848>40%</color>.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

501031.name: Synchronous Preparation 1
501031.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking, restores HP to self and <color=#F74848>1</color> ally with lowest HP within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles equal to <color=#F74848>3.5%</color> of [Tang]'s body part. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>5</color> times per turn.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

501034.name: Synchronous Preparation 2
501034.SpecificEffects: <skill passiveSkill=501031>[Synchronous Preparation 1]</skill> range increases to <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles.

501035.name: Synchronous Preparation 3
501035.SpecificEffects: <skill passiveSkill=501031>[Synchronous Preparation 1]</skill> Repair AMT increases to <color=#F74848>6%</color>.

501036.name: Synchronous Preparation 4
501036.SpecificEffects: The number of target selection of <skill passiveSkill=501031>[Synchronous Preparation 1]</skill> increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

501041.name: Mutual Benefits 1
501041.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, if an enemy part is destroyed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=5010506>[Shrewdness]</buf>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

501044.name: Mutual Benefits 2
501044.SpecificEffects: When carrying <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=5010506>[Shrewdness]</buf>, Hit Rate and Critical Hit chance increase by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

501045.name: Mutual Benefits 3
501045.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if the target is on <terrian ID=4003081 />, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

501046.name: Mutual Benefits 4
501046.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=5010506>[Shrewdness]</buf>, increases Flamethrower bullet count by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
